units.text: Поиск по сайту Kairali | Kairali – Аюрведическая лечебная деревня
issues: Rule 10 says to keep the brand name 'Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village' unchanged, but the approved terms give a translation for 'The Ayurvedic Healing Village'. I used the approved term. If the full English brand name should stay as is, the title should read 'Поиск по сайту Kairali | Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village'.
